text: Scope split: ScalaFIM can only consume neuroim4s-spaces/reframe4s WorldLink after its image4s/reframe4s pins move to the spatial4s-backed mains (ScalaFIM pins image4s cff0bdc, whose Frame is image4s's own class). That pin bump + migration of ~43 main/113 test ScalaFIM files + deletion of scalafim.image.world {WorldSpace,Identifiers,FrameCatalog,Spaces,SpaceResolver,SpaceError,WorldLink} is the eco-u2-pins cutover. eco-u2-world delivers the providers. Per user (simplify): near-verbatim moves, no new abstractions; WorldLink moved as-is (generic over D), no DirectionalLink/graph interop; no separate dependency-budget gate (build.sbt declares only spatial4s).
